feeds.title: SCOV Law
feeds.description: SCOV Law blog is intended to be a virtual meeting place to discuss legal developments in Vermont, with a focus on the Supreme Court's jurisprudence. The people behind this blog are a group of young Vermont lawyers from all over the state. 'SCOV' stands for Supreme Court of Vermont. The Court has never actually called itself that; we just thought it sounded catchy.

feeds.title: Vermont Bar Association Blog
feeds.description: Vermont's Professional Association of Attorneys, serving the public and the profession for over 240 years. Follow our blog and read articles on court laws, legal policies, ongoing cases & trials, and the latest updates and news.

feeds.title: SCOVT
feeds.description: SCOVT blog is a collection of current decisions of the Vermont Supreme Court selected, edited, rewritten, condensed, and digested by Allan R. Keyes, Esq.

feeds.title: Ethical Grounds
feeds.description: Michael Kennedy covers articles on legal ethics with doses of running & pop culture on the Ethical Grounds Blog. The blog will answer all your questions related to the Vermont Law world.

feeds.title: Downs Rachlin Martin PLLC
feeds.description: The attorneys of DRM develop innovative solutions to complex legal challenges, achieving optimal outcomes for our clients and the communities we serve. We provide exceptional legal services to help our clients thrive, better our communities, and mentor the next generation of leaders. Read articles on Vermont laws, DRM Legislative Previews, upcoming legislations, ongoing cases and more.

feeds.title: Larson & Gallivan Law Blog
feeds.description: We at Larson & Gallivan Law have made it our mission to stand with you at this low point, navigate the justice system with you, and stand up for your rights. Our mission: get you the treatment you need, the help that's available, and back on your feet financially. Learn more about our team, our work, previous client cases, and more

feeds.title: The Law Office of Amy K. Butler, Esquire PLLC Blog
feeds.description: The Law Office of Amy K. Butler has a blog that features articles on family issues, divorce laws, child custody problems, property issues, and other related helpful articles. Legal issues can make life difficult. You can feel overwhelmed by the need to make serious, life-changing decisions without fully understanding the legal implications. Whether you're dealing with family law and divorce issues, or financial matters and bankruptcy, The Law Office of Amy K. Butler, Esquire, PLLC, can help.

feeds.title: Deppman Law PLC Blog
feeds.description: Deppman Law PLC is a general practice law firm located at Vermont. Benj and Lesley Deppman, the firm's attorneys, are focused on achieving practical results for their clients in a timely, professional manner. They represent clients in diverse areas, including real estate, trust and estate planning and probate proceedings, family law, personal injury, corporate organization, and more. Read their blog for articles on laws, vase studies, feature stories, and informative articles on cases, criminal acts, frauds, disputes, and more.

feeds.title: SRH Law Blog
feeds.description: SRH Law PLLC Blog is a mission-driven law firm based in Burlington, Vermont that helps individuals, nonprofits, and businesses make a difference in their communities. Their blog page features articles on different types of laws, acts, policies, the latest news from legal perpective and more.

feeds.title: Rousseau & Ross PLLC Blog
feeds.description: Call Rousseau & Ross to speak with personal injury attorneys in New Hampshire and Vermont with decades of combined experience getting results.

feeds.title: Sheehey Furlong & Behm
feeds.description: Sheehey Furlong & Behm is a Burlington, Vermont law firm that provides a full range of legal services in a variety of practice areas.

feeds.title: Bergeron, Paradis & Fitzpatrick Law Firm
feeds.description: Bergeron, Paradis & Fitzpatrick is a full-service Vermont law firm providing comprehensive and high-quality legal services to individuals and businesses throughout the state. Our skilled and experienced legal team handles a wide range of legal matters, including divorce and family law, real estate, personal injury, business law, and estate planning. Our law blog covers topics related to taxation, laws, government acts, legal issues, criminal laws, property dispute settlements, and more.

feeds.title: Darby Kolter & Roberts LLP
feeds.description: Since 1987 Darby Kolter & Roberts has a distinguished history providing legal services to clients statewide, primarily in Central Vermont. We are a full service firm, providing a full range of legal and litigation services. Clients include national and regional associations, municipalities, individuals, and large and small businesses.

feeds.title: Langrock Sperry & Wool
feeds.description: Langrock Sperry & Wool offers a full range of legal services to business and individual clients throughout Vermont. We are one of the largest law firms in the state, with nearly thirty attorneys and offices in Burlington and Middlebury. We are also one of the oldest firms, celebrating over 60 years of serving Vermonters. But those bare facts do not begin to describe who we are.

feeds.title: Burke Law, P.C. Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest news about Vermont legal policies, recent Burke Law criminal defense cases, and helpful insights into navigating the Vermont legal system.

feeds.title: Vermont Judiciary News
feeds.description: The Vermont judicial branch of government protects the rights of all Vermonters. It does this by ruling on every case in a way that is fair, impartial, and timely. The role of the courts is to protect individual rights and to ensure everyone has a day in court.
